why: rc111 retires Bench Dogs' e_total_charges_c from the ERP order's record and list views and draws ERP-Epicor's own erp_line_total right after erp_misc_amount where a stored record view lacks it. bd_order_line_total_test.php builds those views the way a tenant gets them: ERP-Epicor's own install of the ERP_Orders record view (BaseErpLayout's setFlatPdfActions and setErpDocumentRecordLayout, which store the effective view on every install) over ERP-Core's own record view of the release, then the shipped Bench overlays, against ERP-Core's own vardefs of that release. These are byte copies because CI cannot reach the private sibling repository. BaseErpLayout is fixtures/rc107/BaseErpLayout.php.txt: its bytes are the same at e96897e9 (ERP-Epicor 1.2.112), which test_rc111_layout_pins.py checks where the commit is reachable.

ERP_Orders.record.1.2.107.php.txt.note: ERP-Epicor 1.2.107: the order's record view before ERP Line Total (unchanged since #227 up to 7e3a69c9), the view an upgraded tenant's stored copy was taken from

ERP_Orders.record.1.2.112.php.txt.note: ERP-Epicor 1.2.112: erp_line_total right after erp_misc_amount in the Order Detail panel (7e3a69c9), what a fresh install stores

ERP_Orders.vardefs.1.2.107.php.txt.note: ERP-Epicor 1.2.107's ERP Orders fields: no erp_line_total (an older ERP-Epicor)

ERP_Orders.vardefs.1.2.112.php.txt.note: ERP-Epicor 1.2.112's ERP Orders fields: erp_line_total and erp_line_total_usdollar
